description: This file provides data access layer functions for managing defects and corrective actions in a defect tracking system, including CRUD operations, list retrieval with filtering, and aggregate analytics.

methods.name: Optional[datetime] _dt_from_iso(value: str | None)
methods.description: Converts ISO formatted string with optional 'Z' suffix to datetime object.

methods.name: Optional[date] _date_from_iso(value: str | None)
methods.description: Converts ISO formatted string to date object, handling empty or None values.

methods.name: None _ensure_defect_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection, defect_id: int)
methods.description: Checks if a defect with given ID exists in database, raises HTTP 404 if not.

methods.name: tuple[list[dict[str,Any]],int] list_defects( conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, q: Optional[str], status: Optional[DefectStatus], severity: Optional[Severity], limit: int, offset: int, sort: str, order: str, )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of defects with optional search, filtering, and sorting.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_defect(conn: sqlite3.Connection, defect_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches defect details including images and action counts.

methods.name: int create_defect(conn: sqlite3.Connection, payload: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Inserts a new defect record into database and returns its ID.

methods.name: None update_defect(conn: sqlite3.Connection, defect_id: int, updates: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates defect fields given a defect ID and update data.

methods.name: None delete_defect(conn: sqlite3.Connection, defect_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a defect record by ID.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] list_actions(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, defect_id: Optional[int], include_done: bool)
methods.description: Retrieves corrective actions, optionally filtered by defect ID and status.

methods.name: int create_action(conn: sqlite3.Connection, payload: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new corrective action and returns its ID.

methods.name: None update_action(conn: sqlite3.Connection, action_id: int, updates: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates a corrective action by ID.

methods.name: None delete_action(conn: sqlite3.Connection, action_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a corrective action by ID.

methods.name: int insert_image_record( conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, defect_id: int, file_name: Optional[str], content_type: str, storage_path: str, created_at: str, )
methods.description: Inserts a new image record linked to a defect.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_image_record(conn: sqlite3.Connection, image_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves image details by image ID.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] dashboard_counts(conn: sqlite3.Connection)
methods.description: Generates aggregate counts for dashboard metrics.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] overdue_alerts(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, limit: int)
methods.description: Lists overdue corrective actions with details.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] analytics(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, range_days: int)
methods.description: Provides defect creation and resolution trends along with average resolution days.
